GPSModuleInterface.shared.$userLocation.receive(on: DispatchQueue.main).compactMap { $0 }.sink { [weak self] location in guard let self else { return } self.lastUserLocation = location // Recolocar el modelo desde la cámara actual + delta GPS.Esto // evita el drift acumulado de ARKit sobre distancias largas.if let frame = self.sceneView.session.currentFrame { let camPos = SIMD3<Float>( frame.camera.transform.columns.3.x, frame.camera.transform.columns.3.y, frame.camera.transform.columns.3.z ) self.sceneManager.updateModelPositionFromGPS( userLocation: location, cameraWorldPosition: camPos ) } self.sceneManager.updateVisibility( userLocation: location, horizontalAccuracy: GPSModuleInterface.shared.userHorizontalAccuracy ) // El botón de avanzar depende de si el modelo ya se reveló, así // que se reevalúa con cada lectura de GPS mientras el usuario camina.self.updateNextModelButton() }.store
GPSModuleInterface.shared.$userHeading.receive(on: DispatchQueue.main).sink { [weak self] heading in self.lastHeading = heading }.store

GPSModuleInterface.shared.$tourState.receive(on: DispatchQueue.main).sink { [weak self] state in guard let self else { return } switch state { case.idle,.returning,.completed: self.sceneManager.clearAll(session: self.sceneView.session) self.hasPlacedModel = false self.currentPOIIndex = 0 self.infoButton.isHidden = true self.updateNextModelButton() default: break } }.store
